perOption.r1:c2: Blocks adrenergic effects and reduces T4 to T3 conversion.

perOption.r3:c2: Iodine blocks hormone release; given first, it would feed new hormone synthesis.
perOption.r4:c1: Treats relative adrenal insufficiency and reduces conversion.
perOption.r4:c2: Treats relative adrenal insufficiency and reduces conversion.
perOption.r5:c1: Aspirin displaces thyroid hormone from binding proteins and raises free hormone.
perOption.r5:c2: Aspirin displaces thyroid hormone from binding proteins and raises free hormone.

questions.educationalObjective: Recognize cues of myxedema coma.

questions.stem: For each statement, indicate whether it is accurate or inaccurate.

rows.text: Oxycodone likely helped tip the client into coma
The low sodium is from too much salt loss in sweat
The low temperature should be corrected with an active warming blanket

rationale.correct: Sedatives and infection trigger myxedema coma; hyponatremia is dilutional; warming is passive.

perOption.r1:c1: Hypothyroid clients clear sedatives slowly and are very sensitive to them.
perOption.r1:c2: Hypothyroid clients clear sedatives slowly and are very sensitive to them.
perOption.r3:c1: It is from impaired free water excretion.
perOption.r3:c2: It is from impaired free water excretion.
perOption.r4:c1: Active external warming dilates vessels and can cause shock; passive warming is used.
perOption.r4:c2: Active external warming dilates vessels and can cause shock; passive warming is used.
perOption.r5:c1: So steroids are given before or with thyroid hormone.
perOption.r5:c2: So steroids are given before or with thyroid hormone.

questions.stem: Which actions should the nurse take to prevent another dosing error at home? Select all that apply.

options.text: Do a brown-bag review of every medicine bottle with the daughter

exhibits.title: Primary care clinic
exhibits.body: An 81-year-old client with hypothyroidism has had palpitations, poor sleep and weight loss for 2 months. The client's daughter refills the pill organizer weekly. Two months ago the levothyroxine dose was raised from 75 to 100 mcg; the old bottle was not thrown out. Bone density last year: T-score -2.4 at the hip.
